newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 11.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Dec 11.

text.p: All of Mexico's major ports were open Wednesday as of 1000 local/1600 GMT, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in a daily update.
Smaller boats were restricted from sailing at ports in Ensenada and Rosarito along the Pacific coast where wind speeds were clocked at between 30 and 35 kilometers per hour.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

A new cold front moving southeast at 10 to 15 knots (19 to 28 kilometers/11 to 17 miles per hour) to northern Baja California and Sonora states sending light rains along the coast of Baja California, Sonora, and Sinaloa. Winds from the north and northeast of 10 to 15 knots and waves as high as three to five feet.
Winds in the Gulf of Tehuantepec heading northeast at 15 knots causing waves three to six feet high.
Light rains along the coast of Tamaulipas and Veracruz. Winds from the south and southeast at 10 to 15 knots with wave heights of between three and five feet.
Isolated showers along the coast of Quintana Roo and Yucatan canal. Winds from the southeast at 10 to 15 knots with waves three to five feet high.
